ACE: You come across what looks to be a lake of simmering sand.
Specks of shifting granules swell up in a mound and then--
Pop!!!
From bright white at the surface, to a tawny glow at their deepest points, each burst of the boiling bubbles brings the mixture to a bit darker of a color.
Would any volunteers like to make a perception check?
LUMI: Ooh, I've got it!
LUMI: Okay, I got a 17!
ACE: So, your eyes aren't quite sure what you're looking at,
But it takes just a quick moment for your nose to be in the knows.
One whiff of the air and you immediately recognize the syrupy-sweet smell around you as a mixture of sugar and heat.
You have found a caramel hot spring!
LUMI: Cool!
By the way, I'm glad \PN could hang out with us today to see this too!
EVE: Speaking of, where is Taka?
ACE: I'm afraid the little prince didn't pick up the phone this morning...
I'm sure he's just had a long night and needs his rest, but rest you all assured, he'll be back with us before long!
ACE: It seems he was called away to the Grand Hall on some sudden and urgent business.
No matter, we can fill him in on your adventures next week!
ACE: Anyway, also on a 17, you notice a large, shadowy figure moving somewhere very near what you can only assume is the bottom of the spring.
ZERO: I stab the shadowy figure.
ACE: At a glance, the figure appears to be much deeper within the caramel than your foil would reach.
ZERO: I stab the caramel.
ACE: Well, of course you do.
ACE: All right, so you swiftly draw your Moonlight Stinger with a 'swish!' and plunge it straight into the caramel concoction with a forceful thrust.
ACE: But suddenly, it sticks fast in the gluey goo!
Zoro, please give me a strength save.
ZERO: ...Uh, 11.
ACE: On an 11, you try as best you can to shove your sword through the gelatinous gallimaufry, but you just can't get it deeper than a foot or so.
Zoro quickly learns that caramel can be very hard and sticky when it wants to be.
But, you do manage to free your sword from the goop, albeit newly-crested with a quickly- crystallizing crown of caramel.
ZERO: ...I lick the caramel.
ACE: Ah, so Zoro takes a moment to lick the caramel from his blade.
Let us assume it rapidly cools fast enough so as he would not burn himself.
Any living mortal would fastly find that it is among the most delicious concoctions ever created,
But for Zoro von Zilchenstein, undead lord that he is, it brings no such comfort.
It is too flavorless to enjoy, and yet the still-lingering heat and several unsteady droplets remind him of the blood he is bound by his vampire nature to drink.
EVE: Yveraanya will quickly enchant the caramel to taste more appealing to him.
ACE: Right, Zoro; nevermind anything I just said!
Actually, this is the most delicious caramel you've ever tasted in your un-life.
LUMI: Ooh, I wanna make a caramel popsicle too!
ACE: All right, Phio goes to dip the end of her staff in the caramel, swirling it about in just the same way to mix as much of it onto the end as she can...
ACE: But suddenly!
LUMI: Oh!?
ACE: The shadowy figure from within the depths surges over to your side of the shore, and you feel a tremendous force pulling on your staff from within the caramel current!
LUMI: "Oh! Friends, help-- there's something underneath!"
ACE: ...Caramel-encrusted sword and all?
ZERO: ...Yes.
EVE: Does the caramel qualify as a liquid?
ACE: An interesting inquiry!
What are you thinking?
EVE: I'm curious if Control Fluid will work on it.
ACE: So, you think it will not be quite as effective as it might normally be, but surely there are pockets of molten sugar within the spring that can be manipulated.
EVE: Let's try it.
Yveraanya will cast the spell and attempt to hoist the entire figure straight out of the spring.
ACE: Please give me a... shall we say, flat intelligence check to manipulate these small bubbles of liquid sugar.
ACE: Impressive!
So, yes, you dexterously manage to coax this strange creature of the delicious deep out of its sugary saccharine habitat.
ACE: As its body breaks above the molten surface, you find yourself face to face with...
ACE: A gigantic!
ACE: Writhing!
ACE: Licorice Eel!
LUMI: Oh!!!
ZERO: Important question, red or black licorice?
ACE: Red!
ZERO: Darn.
EVE: You'd really prefer black...?
ACE: Casting magic as easily as if it were a fishing rod, Yveraanya dexterously reels the creature to the spring's surface.
Its body is an unceasing helix of carmine and caramel, viscous cherry fins forming together at its head in a veritable vortex of teeth and lucre.
Searing spurts of sugar surge out across the spring's shore as its tail wildly thrashes about, finally pulled from the deliquescent depths!
You see that this creature is, at minimum, the length of several more humans end to end,
And is perhaps prone to preying on the unsuspecting passersby who dare dip their hands in the sugary spring.
ZERO: I stab the Licorice Eel.
LUMI: But what if it's friendly?!
ACE: An attack roll, please!
You may have advantage, as Yvera currently has this creature suspended in the air for a brief moment!
ZERO: ...Natural 20!
ACE: In an incredible display of caramel-coated combat from Zoro von Zilchenstein, the cadaverous crusader stabs his sacchariferous saber straight into the eel's aberrant eye!
The licorice-like creature tries to blink, but squeals and shivers, every cylinder of its confectionery form howling and convulsing at its honeyed hanger!
With a gnashing and a thrashing, it slams side to side, shattering the glossy glaze of the caramel crest across the sword--
And in its wild rampage, inadvertently pierces itself through its other eye from its soft and sugary insides!
LUMI: "Nice hit, Zoro!!"
ZERO: "Feh... Something like this is nothing."
ACE: You withdraw your rapier as the newly-blinded beast falls to the ground, its head bouncing on the surface of the shore in complete confoundment.
A long and winding licorice tongue lollygags out of its teleost maw, and you see, tied at the end of it...
...Is a birdcage.
ZERO: ...Did we just skip a whole combat with that crit?
ACE: I'll never tell~
EVE: Yveraanya will open the bird cage.
ACE: As you open it, you notice that it seems this cage is enchanted with no small number of sigils.
Some, you recognize as being for protection.
Others, for containment.
But you are able to quickly undo the latch, and no sooner than you do, a small shape sharply shoots out of the enclosure, and buzzes around you!
You quickly recognize the figure as some kind of flying fae, eager to stretch its wings and taste freedom for the first time after surely far too long...
As it does so, you finally get a good look at her...
LUMI: What does she look like?
ACE: A wonderful question!
ACE: Little starlet,
Would you please describe your character to us?
